description:
Build your entire site and buy a domain right from the chat. Just ask Wix for the website you want, including all the functionality you need, and get a complete, business-ready site generated for you in minutes. You can also connect the perfect custom domain to your site and manage everything seamlessly in one place. If you like, you can continue editing it inside the Wix Harmony editor using tons more AI tools and smooth drag and drop.

For developers: build and deploy Wix apps with the Wix CLI, including dashboard extensions, backend APIs, site widgets, service plugins and data collections. Build headless sites with Wix Headless, fully hosted on Wix or self-hosted in any framework, powered by Wix backend services for eCommerce, bookings, CMS, events and members. Manage your store, bookings, contacts and site settings programmatically.

defaultPrompt: Build a minimalist editorial blog website for my homeware brand.
Create a high-contrast running site with bookings and subscriptions.
Create a fresh matcha site with an online store and booking tools.

name: wix

positive.prompt: Show me all my Wix sites
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of the Wix sites in the test account.

positive.prompt: Show me all products I have in my store
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the products in the selected site's store.

positive.prompt: Add another product to my store: white leggings for women, costs $100
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the product was added to the store with the given name and price.

positive.prompt: Generate a site for my barber shop
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a widget with site generation progress; when it finishes, the generated site is rendered in an iframe.

positive.description: Add a staff member to a bookings site
positive.prompt: Add a staff member to my barber shop
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a staff member to the site's Wix Bookings. Requires a site with Wix Bookings installed.

negative.description: Version control: restoring a previous site version isn't supported
negative.prompt: Restore the first version of my site

negative.description: Integrating an external payment provider isn't supported

negative.prompt: Change my site's color scheme to dark blue
